chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
That the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) gave the grandmother one-sixth, and did not fix for her anything specific.

key_terms.يَفْرِضْ: To fix/determine as a specific statutory portion

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandmother in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* records the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) practice of granting the grandmother one-sixth of the estate, a ruling that became the basis for the Shia position on this heir. The phrase 'did not fix for her anything specific' indicates that this share is derived from the Prophet’s discretionary practice (sunna) rather than being a strictly codified, exclusive portion in the Quran, allowing for scholarly nuance in its application when other heirs are present.
